title: Ten
desc: A driving instructor is tasked to take Shakeela, a young woman, to a landlord in Mussoorie. But soon, he finds out that her life is in danger and decides to be her saviour.

title: Sarvam Maya
desc: After crossing paths with a ghost, a Hindu priest embarks on an enlightening journey that causes him to question his faith, his identity and everything he believed to be true.

title: Policeodu
desc: A police officer goes into hiding to bring up his daughter in a safe environment. However, after her life is threatened by deadly gangsters, he must face his past to protect his daughter.

title: Prasanna Vadanam
desc: A man with prosopagnosia realises his condition has a unique advantage when he's entangled in a crime scene, turning his struggle into a powerful investigative tool.

title: K-Ramp
desc: A rich businessman, Krishna, sends his wayward son, Kumar, to Kerala in order to reform him. There, Kumar falls for Mercy, a girl with PTSD and suicidal tendencies.

title: War 2
desc: Things get complicated when Kabir Dhaliwal, a secret agent, is accused of betraying his nation and his former batchmate shoulders the responsibility of finding him.

title: Kaththi
desc: A fugitive encounters his doppelgänger and plots to steal his identity for a quick escape. However, fate intervenes as he chooses to embrace and fight for his look-alike's mission.

title: Pavithra Prema
desc: Manickam locks horns with Ghata Ratthaiah, a corporator, who exploits the public. Shakuntala, a doctor, helps Manickam, unaware that he had raped her in an intoxicated state.

title: Remo
desc: SK, an aspiring actor, falls in love with Kavya, a doctor. However, she is engaged to another man and SK tries to sabotage their relationship by making her fall for him.

title: F2: Fun and Frustration
desc: Two young men hope to control their wives after their respective marriages. However, their chauvinistic attitude often lands them in hilarious situations.

title: Mirai
desc: When a vicious villain sets out to claim nine sacred books that hold the secret to immortality, the guardian of the ninth book ties a happy-go-lucky orphan's destiny to the quest to protect them.

title: Baahubali: The Beginning
desc: Raised by a tribe, a young man sets out to help his lady love rescue an enslaved princess of a kingdom that is ruled by a tyrannical king. In doing so, he soon discovers his true identity.

title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion
desc: After learning that his father was brutally killed by Bhallaladeva, Mahendra Baahubali raises an army to defeat him and release his mother from the former's captivity.

title: Raja the Great
desc: Raja, a person with visual impairment, is skilled and sets out on a mission to rescue a girl, Lucky, the pampered daughter of a sincere police officer.
